_how_to_use: Every hub page (occasion, recipient, product type) is generated from this file + products.json. A hub page is only generated if it has >= 3 published products OR a written guide. 'keywords' = the searches that page is built to answer. Volumes are only listed where a source exists; everything else is a candidate keyword (no verified volume).
_volume_source: NWW Marketing Plan v2 (Jul 2026), keyword research recorded in Jackson's project notes: 'corporate gifts' 60,500/mo (difficulty 41); '5th anniversary gift' 9,900/mo (difficulty 38), peaks at 40,500 in May vs 5,400 in Jan; 'recipe cutting board' 590/mo with only 4,134 Etsy listings. Etsy audit (Aug 2026) untapped targets: groomsmen gift, closing gift for buyers, client appreciation gift, employee appreciation bulk, retirement gift for coworker, bbq gift for dad, first home gift for couple, christmas hostess gift, bridal shower gift for bride.
